{{Quote|Fancy meeting you at the spaceport this time of night. A little out of the way for you, isn't it?''"<br />"''Yes, well, ah, I'm meeting an old friend. He's coming in on the shuttle from Dreve.|Vexan and Reshig|<ref name="Shuttle">{{WEGCite|story=Waiting For The Late-Night Shuttle|book=Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations}}</ref>}}
'''Dreve''' was a celestial body<ref name="Shuttle" /> located in the [[Dreve system/Legends|Dreve system]], a part of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> By approximately [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="GG11date">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', including "[[Waiting For The Late-Night Shuttle]]," is set around six [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of {{Film|VI}}, which corresponds to approximately [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> when the corrupt [[Constable/Legends|constable]] [[Vexan]], who was under the employ of<ref name="Shuttle" /> the [[loan shark]]<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref> [[Sires Vant]]<ref name="Shuttle" /> of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Andasala/Legends|Andasala]]<ref name="GG11" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Andasala system/Legends|Andasala system]]</ref> encountered the individual [[Reshig]] at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] at [[Local day/Legends|night]], the latter, who was in debt to Vant, claimed that they were meeting an "old friend" who was supposedly arriving on a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] from Dreve. However, the loan shark had previously learned that Reshig had bought a shuttle ticket in order to depart the planet, and the constable noted to Reshig that there were no incoming shuttles at that [[Time/Legends|time]] of the day, exposing their ruse.<ref name="Shuttle" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dreve was mentioned in "[[Waiting For The Late-Night Shuttle]]," a short companion narrative included in [[Rick D. Stuart]]'s [[1994]] [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''.<ref name="Shuttle" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Dreve [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Dreve itself, in grid square N-7.<ref name="TEA" />
